request: 通过Quest扳机控制内走线Dex1闭合，保留官方运控站立与arm_sdk上肢路径

readonly_probe.limitation: Finite observation, not proof of permanent endpoint absence. Endpoint discovery is not proof of actual command traffic.

finding: Official internal Dex1 controller rejects motion_mode. No verified internal Dex1 arm_sdk or independent transport identified. External dex1_1_service requires its serial hardware path; starting it does not establish access to the internal grippers.
existing_trigger_logic: 0..1 maps full-open to near-closed, with velocity/acceleration limits, closing-error freeze, opening release and stale-input protection; available in existing debug transport only.
next_required_evidence: Firmware-specific documented interface for internal Dex1 concurrent with ai/FSM501: topic, message fields/indices, units, authority and stop semantics; alternatively a manufacturer-supported independent hardware connection.
preserved_constraints: No lowcmd publisher alongside official locomotion
No reactivation of frozen custom lower-body route

web_research.conclusion: No verified internal Dex1 + arm_sdk solution or enabling firmware version found. Unverified does not mean impossible. A real-hardware success report uses independent Dex1 DDS, a different transport.

sources.finding: Internal arm_sdk control unverified; motion unsupported.

Author reports 2026-06-13 real G1 arm and right Dex1 operation with stock locomotion. PR code reviewed: rt/dex1/right/cmd MotorCmds_ and right/state MotorStates_; only right gripper. No internal slot31/33 support evidence.
PR code reviewed: detects internal and external Dex1, explicitly rejects internal type.
Serial-to-DDS driver; needs compatible independent serial hardware, not a lowstate bridge.
Serial motor calibration issue; not internal arm_sdk compatibility.

web_research.limitations: Search not exhaustive; third-party hardware reports not independently reproduced. No robot commands or controller changes in this research.
web_research.next_step: Read-only robot-side service/configuration and serial hardware inventory may distinguish a stopped independent service from absent hardware. Do not blindly start serial detection/calibration. Independent connection is conditional on hardware compatibility; keeping internal wiring requires protocol evidence or a separately designed supervised experiment.
